Package com.github.crittscott.somebuckets.gametest

Class SharedGameTestSupport

java.lang.Object
com.github.crittscott.somebuckets.gametest.SharedGameTestSupport
Direct Known Subclasses:
GameTestSupport
abstract class SharedGameTestSupport extends Object
Supplies vanilla and loader-neutral setup and assertions to all three loader GameTest suites.
